title: Add an item and use it right away
description: A photo with clean edges turns into a card for your own outfits.

blocks.text: The first obstacle is how laborious uploading clothes is, especially when automatic processing removes details that were needed.

quote.text: I am so far liking the app but the photos are never clean or straight or have a good background like in the overview of the app if anyone has tips I could use them.

blocks.text: Keep the original, allow an edge to be restored and start with a few items. Descriptions and finished outfits should survive a photo being replaced.
The same upload time should not be promised for every fabric and shape. Removing the repeated work matters more.
